description: Gulf State Park is a 6,150-acre state park featuring beach pavilions, nature center, swimming pool, Lake Shelby day-use area with kayaking and canoeing, fishing and education pier, backcountry biking trails, butterfly garden, learning campus, interpretive center, hiking trails, geocaching, paddle sports, and more. The park offers accommodations including The Lodge at Gulf State Park (Hilton Hotel), lakeside cabins, woods cabins, eagle cottages, improved 496-site campground with full hookups, primitive camping, and glamping sites.
